title: Dagger Enchantments
description: Combat-focused mod that adds magical dagger enchantments.
body:
🗡️ Dagger Enchantments

Dagger Enchantments introduces a new combat progression built around lightweight daggers and exclusive enchantments.

The mod focuses on fast melee combat, stealth mechanics, and risk-reward gameplay. Daggers are quick weapons with lower base damage, but their true power is unlocked through rare enchantment books discovered during exploration.

Instead of brute force, this mod rewards mobility, timing, and smart positioning.

🔪 Daggers

The mod adds several lightweight daggers:

Stone Dagger

Iron Dagger

Gold Dagger

Diamond Dagger

Netherite Dagger

Ethereal Dagger (endgame weapon)

Daggers are designed to be:

⚡ Faster than swords

🎯 Lower base damage

🧠 Built around enchantment synergy

They shine when combined with rare enchantments and critical strikes.

✨ Exclusive Enchantments

These enchantments are dagger-only and cannot be applied to vanilla weapons.

🧪 Poison

Chance to apply Poison on hit.

Effective against high-HP enemies

Works especially well with fast dagger attacks

Great for sustained damage

🏹 Hunter

Deals bonus damage to hostile mobs.

Ideal for exploration and dungeon combat

Reliable damage increase against monsters

🌫️ Shadow Step

Chance to grant temporary invisibility and speed when attacking.

Encourages aggressive mobility

Perfect for stealth-style combat

🔇 Silence

Applies Weakness, Slowness, and Mining Fatigue to enemies.

Strong crowd-control effect

Makes dangerous enemies far less threatening

⚡ Execution

A powerful endgame enchantment.

Deals massive bonus damage to low-health enemies

Perfect for finishing enemies quickly

🪨 Heavy

Enhances fall-based attacks.

Increases damage when striking enemies while falling

Pairs extremely well with aerial dagger abilities

📦 How to Obtain Enchantments (Survival)

Most enchantment books cannot be crafted and do not appear in the enchanting table.

They are obtained through exploration:

Dungeon chests

Abandoned mineshafts

Other vanilla structure loot

Rare, but rewarding.

If you find one — you earned it.

⚔️ Ethereal Dagger

The Ethereal Dagger is the mod's endgame weapon.

It features special combat abilities:

Ascending Slash – launch upward and strike from above

Ethereal Slash – powerful sweeping attack

These abilities create dynamic, skill-based combat moments.

⚖️ Balance Philosophy

This mod is designed to feel vanilla-friendly.

Key design principles:

🎲 Chance-based effects instead of guaranteed damage

⚔️ Skill and positioning matter

📉 No excessive power creep

🎮 Balanced for both singleplayer and multiplayer

Daggers are deadly — but only in the right hands.

🌍 Multiplayer Friendly

Server-side safe

No client-only exploits

Works perfectly in SMP and co-op servers

🛠️ Technical Information

Minecraft 1.20.1

Forge 47.x

Fully survival compatible

No required dependencies

❤️ Final Notes

Dagger Enchantments aims to expand Minecraft combat without breaking its vanilla feel.

If you enjoy fast melee combat, stealth mechanics, and meaningful loot progression, this mod is for you.

Strike fast. Strike first. 🗡️
